description: Researcher Jim Fan presents the next grand challenge in the quest for AI: the "foundation agent," which would seamlessly operate across both the virtual and physical worlds. He explains how this technology could fundamentally change our lives — permeating everything from video games and metaverses to drones and humanoid robots — and explores how a single model could master skills across these different realities. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
classificationReason: Directly addresses an AI agent operating across virtual and physical worlds, including drones and humanoid robots.
qualityReason: Likely a substantive research presentation from a leading investigator with a coherent technical thesis.
